faq.q: How many questions are on the MLA-C01 exam, and how long is it?
faq.a: MLA-C01 has 65 questions and a time limit of 130 minutes. Questions are multiple-choice and multiple-response.
A score of 720 or higher out of 1000 is required to pass. Scores are scaled to account for question difficulty, so they are not the same as a simple percentage of correct answers.

faq.q: How much does the exam cost, and how do I register?
faq.a: The exam fee is US $150. You can take it through Pearson VUE at a test center or as an online proctored exam. There is no free retake, so you pay the full fee each time you sit the exam.

faq.q: How long is the certification valid, and how do I recertify?
faq.a: The certification is valid for 3 years after you pass, and you must recertify before it expires. Passing the exam earns you a 50% discount voucher for your next exam, which you can use to recertify or to take another AWS certification.

faq.q: Can I take the exam in Korean?
faq.a: Yes. The exam is offered in 4 languages, including Korean. You can choose your language when you register for the exam.
